name: The Ashen Dragon
look: A colossal dragon 26 m long with a 30 m wingspan: soot-black scales that crack into glowing orange seams along the throat and belly, ragged wings with ash-grey membranes, a crown of back-swept horns, a spined tail ending in a heavy bony club, molten light in the jaws.
ramps: stone 0-7 (scales), fire 4-15 (seams, breath), slate 3-8 (membranes), bone 6-12 (horns, teeth)

idle.note: Standing at rest, slow breathing and a small weight shift; F6 flows back into F1.

walk.note: Walking loop in place (the game moves the sprite); F6 flows into F1.

run.note: Running loop in place, leaning into the run; F6 flows into F1.

takeoff.note: Take-off (its jump): crouch, wings up, spring on F3; the game lifts it.

fly.note: Flying loop, one full wingbeat. The game sets the altitude; draw the lowest point (feet or tail) just above the ground line.

fly_fast.note: Fast flight: body stretched out flat, hard short wingbeats.

land.note: Landing: wings flare, feet touch on F4.

bite.note: Darting bite. Melee attack; damage lands on F4.

claw.note: Rakes a forefoot. Melee attack; damage lands on F4.

tail_whip.note: Swings round and whips the tail club. Melee attack; damage lands on F4.

wing_buffet.note: Rears and beats both wings to knock the player back. Slow heavy attack with a long, readable wind-up; damage lands on F5.

fire_breath.note: Breathes fire from the ground. Breath attack: the game plays F4-F5 in a loop while it breathes. Paint only the glow in the mouth; the game draws the breath stream.

air_breath.note: Breathes fire while flying (wings spread, body above the ground line). Breath attack: the game plays F4-F5 in a loop while it breathes. Paint only the glow in the mouth; the game draws the breath stream.

roar.note: Roar / taunt: head up, jaws wide on F3-F4.

hurt.note: Pain flinch: knocked back on F1-F2, recovers to the idle pose by F6.

death.note: Death: collapses onto the ground line. F6 is held, then swapped for the corpse, so F6 must match the corpse sheet in the same direction.
